The bottom half is opaque beige plastic with molded details including holes and slots. The image appears to be AI-generated due to nonsensical text and slight structural irregularities.

The functional openings for the tape player mechanism are missing or malformed into random holes. The structural logic of the cassette bottom is incorrect.
The spools lack the detailed winding of magnetic tape; they appear as smooth, metallic-looking discs rather than plastic hubs with wound tape.
